notes: External PDFs should stay out of the long-term archive and be reacquired only as temporary scratch.
Use the archive size profile snapshot to decide whether a retained scratch item is still worth its byte cost.
When a real rematch-world benchmark run is distilled, prefer retaining one evidence packet plus one hashed evidence receipt and let wider traces remain scratch-only.

After the bundle, preflight, and spine-audit receipts agree, use the retention-exit receipt to decide exactly which scratch traces and reconstructible intermediates may leave before the next revision zip.

After the retention-exit receipt is ready, use scripts/tools/prune_rematch_world_benchmark_transients.py to delete concrete exit-ready scratch/intermediate files instead of carrying them into the next revision zip.
retention_rule: Keep only scratch that is cited by a process note or needed for the next session; otherwise remove it before cutting the next revision zip.
